--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[AUTH-1] Middleware allows auth bypass on misconfig or errors
File: src/middleware.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The middleware returns NextResponse.next() early when !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and the outer try/catch also returns NextResponse.next() on any error, effectively skipping protection. This short-circuits the Clerk protection and swallows runtime failures.  
Impact: Admin and protected API routes (e.g. /api/admin/*) can be accessed without authentication if envs are missing or middleware throws — a full trust‑boundary breach at scale.  
Fix: Fail closed: remove the env short‑circuit and change the catch to return a 401/redirect (or a safe error) so requests are not allowed through on misconfiguration or runtime errors.

[AUTH-2] Missing index on provider ID causing table scans
File: prisma/schema.prisma (L1-L100)
Evidence: User model defines clerkId String? with no @index or @unique, while server code does prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { clerkId: userId } }) in admin auth flows.  
Impact: Every auth lookup by clerkId will be a full-table scan as User count grows, causing DB CPU exhaustion and auth outages under moderate traffic.  
Fix: Add an index or unique constraint on clerkId (e.g., @@index([clerkId]) or make it unique if applicable) and run a migration; update queries to use findUnique/findFirst with indexed fields.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[AUTH-3] Coupon decrement race in checkout (no transaction)
File: src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: Code reads coupon.quantity then issues a separate prisma.coupon.update({ quantity: coupon.quantity - 1 }) without a transaction or conditional update.  
Impact: Concurrent checkouts can overspend limited coupons or allow negative quantities under modest concurrency, leading to revenue/UX issues.  
Fix: Perform atomic decrement in a transaction or an update with a WHERE quantity > 0 and check affected rows (or use SELECT FOR UPDATE).

[AUTH-4] N+1 queries in admin abandoned-carts endpoint
File: src/app/api/admin/abandoned-carts/route.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: Fetches partial checkouts then maps each to prisma.cart.findUnique and for each cart item runs prisma.product.findUnique, creating many separate DB queries (Promise.all over per-item queries).  
Impact: Admin listing can generate dozens/hundreds of DB queries and spike latency/connection usage as data grows.  
Fix: Batch includes/joins (use findMany with nested include/select) or bulk fetch product rows and map them to avoid N+1 queries.

[AUTH-5] Razorpay webhook is not idempotent when calling external service
File: src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/route.ts (L1-L240)
Evidence: On 'captured' the handler updates the order then unconditionally calls ShiprocketService.createOrder and updates order with shiprocket ids, with no check for existing shiprocketOrderId or persisted idempotency key.  
Impact: Retry or duplicate webhooks can create duplicate Shiprocket orders/shipments and inconsistent state under real webhook retry behavior.  
Fix: Make the handler idempotent: check order.shiprocketOrderId before creating, persist an idempotency key or use a conditional update and transaction to ensure a single external creation.

--- INFO ---

[AUTH-6] Clerk webhook signature verification implemented
File: src/app/api/webhooks/clerk/route.ts
Evidence: Uses svix.Webhook.verify with CLERK_SIGNING_SECRET and required svix headers, which properly validates Clerk webhook origin.
